findings.file_line: crates/hsk-studio-reel/src/wav.rs:314 (deliver_end = want_end.min(available)), :345-372 (loop and cursor), :374 (`let delivered = deliver_end.saturating_sub(start)`), :375-378 (Truncated, then delivery_complete(req, delivered)), :392 (actual.end_pts = deliver_end); contrast pcm.rs:543 (cursor.saturating_sub(start)), y4m.rs:371 (u64::from(chunks)); claim text: lib.rs DESCRIPTOR export.rule ('the packet, wav, y4m, PCM and mxf receipts take complete from the units delivered'), model.rs:474-477, lane notes.remediation_R10.v4_06 (wav.rs:378 'fixed')
findings.evidence: At the wav site the number handed to delivery_complete is computed from the request (want_end = start + req.count) clamped by the file's sample count, not from what the loop handed to the sink. Line 378 is reached only when deliver_end == want_end (deliver_end < want_end returns Truncated at :375-377), so delivered = want_end - start = req.count by arithmetic alone, whatever the loop did; it also equals cursor - start (the loop advances cursor by n >= 1 until cursor == deliver_end and a short read returns Truncated first), so today delivery_complete(req, delivered) can only return Ok(true) there and the comparison is a tautology; the class 'unit count taken from the request' is therefore not removed structurally at this site, only made unreachable, and no test pins it (a revert to `complete: true` at wav.rs:378, y4m.rs:372, pcm.rs:544 or mxf provider.rs:261 keeps every test green, because only the helper is unit-tested). The lane's V4-06 regex has no token for `delivered =`, so the site is not on its list. The DESCRIPTOR sentence and the model.rs doc cite delivery_complete_is_computed_from_delivered_units, which proves the helper, not the wav call site.
findings.fail_relevance: none by itself: no input yields a wrong receipt; process/doc note (CONFIRMED process/doc-only items are notes under the R10 fold rule)
findings.remediation: wav.rs:374 `let delivered = cursor.saturating_sub(start);` (the pcm.rs:543 pattern) so every site reads the loop's own count; add the token `delivered =` to the V4-06 regex; or weaken the DESCRIPTOR/doc wording to 'from the loop count (y4m, PCM, packet, mxf) or the loop's end position (wav)'
